title: Somalia Launches Open Budget Survey 2025 to Promote Transparency and Public Accountability
excerpt: The Ministry of Finance and UNICEF officially launched the Somalia Open Budget Survey 2025 in Mogadishu to strengthen budget transparency, citizen participation and oversight.

content:
MOGADISHU, SOMALIA – 24 November 2026. The Federal Government of Somalia, through the Ministry of Finance, in collaboration with the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), officially launched the Somalia Open Budget Survey 2025 at an event held at Decale Hotel in Mogadishu.

The launch marks an important development in ongoing efforts to strengthen public financial management, promote government transparency, and encourage greater citizen participation in national budget processes.

The Open Budget Survey is an international assessment framework that examines how governments make budget information publicly available, provide opportunities for citizens to participate in budget decisions, and ensure effective oversight of public finances.

For Somalia, strengthening these areas is particularly important as the country continues to develop its public institutions and improve systems of governance and financial accountability.

The survey provides an opportunity to examine the accessibility of government budget information, the extent of public engagement in budget decisions, and the effectiveness of institutional oversight mechanisms.

Public participation is especially important because national budget decisions directly influence the delivery of essential services, including education, healthcare, water, sanitation, and social protection.

The collaboration between the Ministry of Finance and UNICEF reflects the importance of institutional partnerships in promoting transparent, inclusive, and accountable public financial management.

The successful implementation of open budget principles requires more than the publication of financial documents. It also requires accessible information, active citizen engagement, effective parliamentary oversight, and continuous institutional improvements.

The launch of the Somalia Open Budget Survey 2025 therefore provides an opportunity to strengthen dialogue among government institutions, development partners, civil society organizations, and citizens on the future of public financial transparency in Somalia.

Transparency in public budgeting is not simply a financial management requirement; it is an essential foundation for accountable governance and sustainable national development.
